title: Induced Smectic Phase Formed by New Liquid Crystalline Binary Systems Consisting of Main Chain Polymer and Twin Compound
abstract: Abstract                The thermal and mesomorphic properties of the new liquid crystalline binary systems, consisting of a nematic main chain liquid crystalline polymer and a nematic twin liquid crystal, have been studied. The liquid crystalline binary systems formed an induced smectic A phase, which was characterized by a uniaxial conoscopic figure, a fan texture, and a broad X-ray scattering peak at the wide angle.
